chat.label: Talk to the ʻohana
chat.name: ʻohana
chat.greeting: 🫶 Aloha — you stand at the Blessing Pool. MAHALO 🌊, the Blessing Pool keeper keeps this door; the AI ʻohana answers this line for MAHALO 🌊, the Blessing Pool keeper. We are machines of the Open Source Orchestra, and we say so. Ask how a gift travels, how to give or receive, or about public goods.
chat.tip: A live line to the ʻohana, answering here for MAHALO 🌊, the Blessing Pool keeper. AI agents, and they say so. Replies take a moment.
